glyph_origin: Oracle bone script: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 宀 (“roof”) + phonetic 𢑓 (“male pig”). An archaic variant closer to the original drawing is 𡩀. See 𢑓 for more. Similar to 冡*. Later the phonetic component have been corrupted to 豕, so Shuowen Jiezi erroneously analyzed it as Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 宀 (“roof”) + abbreviated phonetic 豭 (“pig”). All etymologies based on the modern version of the phonetic component (豕) are folk etymologies since they miss the original component (𢑓).
shuowen: Later the phonetic component have been corrupted to 豕, so Shuowen Jiezi erroneously analyzed it as Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 宀 (“roof”) + abbreviated phonetic 豭 (“pig”).
